title: Joash Repairs the Temple

questions.question: How long did Jehoash (Joash) reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:1 (ESV): "...and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who instructed Jehoash so that he did what was right?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:2 (ESV): "And Jehoash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all his days, because Jehoiada the priest instructed him."

questions.question: What did Jehoash order the priests to repair?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:5 (ESV): "...let them repair the house of the LORD wherever any need of repair is found."

questions.question: Who attacked Gath and then set his face against Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:17 (ESV): "At that time Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath... Then Hazael set his face to go up against Jerusalem."

questions.question: How did Jehoash save Jerusalem from Hazael?
options: He gave him all the sacred gifts and gold from the temple and palace
questions.correctAnswer: He gave him all the sacred gifts and gold from the temple and palace
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:18 (ESV): "And Joash king of Judah took all the sacred gifts... and sent them to Hazael king of Syria. Then Hazael went away from Jerusalem."

questions.question: Did the priests repair the breaches of the house by the twenty-third year?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:6 (ESV): "But by the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house."

questions.question: What new system did Jehoiada set up for collections?
options: A chest with a hole in the lid beside the altar
questions.correctAnswer: A chest with a hole in the lid beside the altar
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:9 (ESV): "Then Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in the lid of it and set it beside the altar..."

questions.question: How did Jehoash die?
options: His servants conspired and struck him down
questions.correctAnswer: His servants conspired and struck him down
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:20 (ESV): "His servants arose and made a conspiracy and struck down Joash..."

questions.question: What happened to the money brought into the temple under the new system?
options: It was given into the hands of the workmen to repair the house
questions.correctAnswer: It was given into the hands of the workmen to repair the house
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:11 (ESV): "And they gave the money... into the hands of the workmen..."

questions.question: Was the money used for basins of silver, snuffers, bowls, etc.?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:13 (ESV): "But there were not made for the house of the LORD basins of silver, snuffers, bowls, trumpets, or any vessels... from the money..."

questions.question: Why did they not ask for an accounting from the men who paid the workmen?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:15 (ESV): "And they did not ask an accounting from the men... for they dealt honestly."

questions.question: Who was legally entitled to the money from the guilt offerings and sin offerings?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:16 (ESV): "The money from the guilt offerings and the money from the sin offerings was not brought into the house of the LORD; it belonged to the priests."

questions.question: Where was Joash killed?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:20 (ESV): "...struck down Joash in the house of Millo..."

questions.question: Who were the conspirators who killed Joash?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:21 (ESV): "Jozacar the son of Shimeath and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him down..."

questions.question: Who was Joash's mother?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 12:1 (ESV): "...His mother's name was Zibiah of Beersheba."

key_verse_text: And Jehoash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all his days, because Jehoiada the priest instructed him. (ESV)
